summary_md: **Natural Language Processing Papers ([@HEI](https://x.com/HEI/status/2116675426210787577))** shares *A Harness Reducing over-Defensive Writing in Agents by Isolating Objections* by Xiaochen Chang ([arXiv 2610.36717](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36717)), which splits reviewer, filter and writer into separate contexts so writer agents stop overclaiming and then disclaiming for an adversarial AI reviewer.

referenced_urls.title: A Harness Reducing over-Defensive Writing in Agents by Isolating Objections

relevance: Harness design for better agent writing.

media.description: Abstract of the paper presenting a harness that isolates reviewer, filter and writer roles to reduce over-defensive agent writing.
media.ocr_text: When expanding a report, writing with agents may introduce a stronger claim than the article makes and then disclaim it. This is called over-defensive writing. We assume that this is because the agent is writing for responding to an adversarial AI reviewer, instead of a human reader. The defensive context may also influnce the consequent when we simply ban defensive writing in the output through prompts. In order to reduce over-defensive writing, we produce a harness that separates the reviewer, filter, and writer. The writer agent receives only the problems choosen by the filter, which is an independent context.
